The '''''Wanderer''''' was a modified [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI bulk transport]], that was owned by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Lavek Talstin]].

==History==
Talstin purchased the ''Wanderer'' and used it as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. He later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the ''Wanderer'' became an Alliance supply [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and operated out of the world [[Cuirilla]].
